results.title: Gentherm Shareholders Approve Combination with Modine’s Performance Technologies Business
results.author: Na
results.description: Gentherm shareholders voted to approve the proposed combination with Modine's Performance Technologies business, with approximately 99% voting in favor of share issuance and 94% supporting charter amendments. The transaction has received all required regulatory approvals and is expected to close on October 1, 2026. The combined entity aims to create a higher-growth, higher-margin thermal and precision flow management business.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong shareholder approval (99% for share issuance, 94% for charter amendment), all regulatory approvals obtained, expected transaction close date confirmed, and management expects the combination to accelerate transformation into a higher-growth, higher-margin business with meaningful profitable growth opportunities.

Successful completion of regulatory approvals including IRS Private Letter Ruling, shareholders receiving Gentherm stock consideration, and the Performance Technologies business positioned to benefit from combined entity's scale and market positioning in thermal and precision flow management.

results.title: Got $1,000? 3 Stocks Building the Physical Artificial Intelligence (AI) Era
results.author: Micah Zimmerman
results.description: As AI systems grow more powerful, investors can benefit from companies building physical infrastructure rather than just software. Three stocks stand out: Astera Labs provides semiconductor connectivity solutions, Modine manufactures cooling systems for data centers, and Flex offers manufacturing and systems integration services. The article recommends allocating $350 to Astera, $350 to Modine, and $300 to Flex.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Positioned as an overlooked company with critical technology for AI systems; its fabric switches and connectivity solutions address essential data movement bottlenecks as AI systems become more complex.

Offers exposure to unavoidable physical constraint (heat management); secured $4 billion long-term customer agreement through 2029 with $165 million upfront payment, demonstrating strong demand and commitment.
Well-positioned in manufacturing and systems integration of AI infrastructure; manufacturing AMD's AI systems and offering modular designs that reduce deployment timelines by up to 30%.
Mentioned as a partner whose AI systems are being manufactured by Flex; not the primary focus of the article's investment thesis.

results.title: Surging Demand: Data Center Direct-to-Chip Cooling Market Poised for 26.5% CAGR Growth by 2032
results.author: Researchandmarkets.Com
results.description: The data center direct-to-chip cooling market is expected to grow from $3.33 billion in 2026 to $17.31 billion by 2032, driven by increasing demand for thermal management in AI and hyperscale computing. Single-phase systems and water-glycol coolants dominate the market, with hyperscale data centers leading adoption due to energy efficiency and sustainability goals.

results.title: Why Modine Manufacturing Stock Is Rocketing Higher Today
results.author: Josh Kohn-Lindquist
results.description: Modine Manufacturing announced a major $4 billion deal with a hyperscale data center customer for cooling solutions spanning 2027-2029, including a $165 million upfront payment. The deal, representing approximately $1.3 billion in annual revenue starting 2027, significantly exceeds the company's 2025 data center sales of $700 million. With a planned spinoff of its lower-margin performance technologies unit by Q4 2026, Modine is positioned to become a pure-play growth stock focused on data center cooling amid the ongoing AI infrastructure boom.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company secured a landmark $4 billion multi-year contract with a major hyperscaler customer, demonstrating market leadership in data center cooling solutions. The deal validates the company's long-term strategy and positions it for significant revenue growth in the high-margin data center segment. The stock surged 16.8% on the announcement, reflecting strong market confidence in the company's future prospects as it transitions to a pure-play growth company.

results.author: Itai Smidt
results.description: US equities rallied post-Memorial Day with strong AI and small-cap leadership, as de-escalation hopes in the US-Iran conflict drove oil prices lower. Micron Technology surged 18% to cross $1 trillion market cap on a UBS price target hike, while quantum computing and space stocks rallied on government funding and SpaceX IPO anticipation. The Nasdaq rose 1.11% and Russell 2000 jumped 1.74%, though the Dow declined 0.19% as defensive sectors unwound.
